name: Kitaoka Haruna
source:
"The Headlong Tsundere Wolf"
Hobbies: Collecting bear goods

A second-year and a member of the "Spy Club". An ex-member and ace of a sports club, Haruna came to the school due to the sports scholarship. However, after getting injured this spring, she was forced to quit the sports club and instead joined the Spy Club. Despite her tsundere personality, she loves sweet and cute things, and especially bears.

"There's no way that I'm jealous of some bear!!"

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=689783]The Getchu site[/url]]
